question: Which former RBI Governor became PM’s Principal Secretary, signaling strong economic emphasis in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaktikanta Das**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shaktikanta Das**, the former **Governor** of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, was appointed as the **Principal Secretary** to the **Prime Minister** in **February 2025**.
 
• This high-profile appointment signaled a major shift toward a **strong economic emphasis** within the **Prime Minister's Office (PMO)**, leveraging his extensive experience in **fiscal policy** and **monetary management**.
 
• He is a retired **IAS officer** of the **1980 batch** from the **Tamil Nadu cadre**, having served in various capacities in both the state and central governments.
 
• As the **Principal Secretary**, his role involves managing the administrative operations of the **PMO**, coordinating policy matters across various **Ministries**, and advising the **Prime Minister** on **macroeconomic stability** and **governance reforms**.
